intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in the Ahmedabad region. This page compares recorded fees and placements from our database opened in {{year}}.

Ganpat University vs St Xavier's College for B.Sc is a private university compared with a city college. St Xavier's has the only placement record on this page, from 2023, and the lower recorded year fee.

sections.heading: Ganpat University vs St Xavier's College for B.Sc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose St Xavier's College if you want a lower recorded year fee, at ₹9,985, and a 2023 placement record, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh.

Choose Ganpat University if you want a private university B.Sc and have budgeted for recorded tuition of ₹40,000 or ₹72,000 a year, depending on the programme. This page has no Ganpat placement row for B.Sc.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Ganpat University has recorded B.Sc tuition of ₹40,000 and ₹72,000 a year, depending on the programme. Treat these as year fees, not confirmed programme totals.

St Xavier's College has a recorded year-wise total of ₹9,985. That figure is above our general fee floor of ₹1,000, and it is consistent with a low-fee city college, but you should still confirm the official circular, including laboratory charges.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: St Xavier's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹9 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
Ganpat University has no B.Sc placement row on this page. Ask the university for its latest official undergraduate science placement or internship report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. Many B.Sc admissions in Gujarat are based on Class 12 science marks.
Read the current official admissions page of each institute for subject combinations and any university-level process.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: St Xavier's College is in Ahmedabad. Ganpat University's main campus is at Kherva, in Mehsana district, even though this comparison is listed against the Ahmedabad region.
Visit the teaching campus you will join. The commute is not the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: On the data we hold, St Xavier's College is the more complete side: a recorded year fee of ₹9,985 and 2023 placement figures.
Ganpat University may still suit you if you want a university campus and have checked the official fee for your B.Sc specialisation.
Confirm both official circulars, and ask Ganpat for a placement report, before you decide.
